title: PdMATE16 and PdMATE35 are essential for the accumulation of multiple flavonoids in tree peonies.
authors: Yuan, Meng; Wei, Xinrui; Peng, Fucheng; Wang, Qun; Zhou, Lin; Wang, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芍药MATE转运蛋白对类黄酮的运输功能，虽涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子转运而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: As a plant with both medicinal and edible uses, peonies are not only valued for their ornamental qualities, but also for the high economic value of the flavonoids found in their petals. However, the regulatory mechanisms governing flower color and flavonoid transport remain unclear. The multidrug and toxic compound extrusion (MATE) family of proteins are important transport protein involved in the transport of a variety of secondary metabolites in plants. Based on transcriptomic data, this study identified 37 MATE genes from the transcriptomic data of Paeonia delavayi var. lutea. Molecular docking and site-directed mutagenesis results predict that PdMATE16 and PdMATE35 can bind multiple pigments. Overexpression and virus-induced gene silencing (VIGS) experiments further confirmed that PdMATE16 and PdMATE35 could transport a variety of flavonoid compounds, including flavone glycosides, flavonol glycosides, chalcone glycosides and anthocyanin glycosides. These substances not only give peonies their yellow color, but are also the main active ingredients in medicinal applications. In addition, several transcription factors that may be involved in regulating MATE gene expression were screened. Our research confirms the key role of PdMATE16 and PdMATE35 in flavonoid transport in peonies, clarifies the regulatory mechanism underlying the transport processes involved in peony coloration, and may thus contribute to the improvement of ornamental and medicinal plants.
abstract_zh: 作为兼具药用与食用价值的植物，牡丹不仅因其观赏特性而备受珍视，其花瓣中的类黄酮化合物也具有极高的经济价值。然而，调控花色及类黄酮转运的机制仍不清楚。多药及毒性化合物外排（MATE）家族蛋白是植物中参与多种次生代谢物转运的重要转运蛋白。基于转录组数据，本研究从黄牡丹（Paeonia delavayi var. lutea）的转录组信息中鉴定出37个MATE基因。分子对接和定点突变实验结果表明，PdMATE16和PdMATE35能够与多种色素结合。过表达和病毒诱导基因沉默（VIGS）实验进一步证实，PdMATE16和PdMATE35可转运多种类黄酮化合物，包括黄酮糖苷、黄酮醇糖苷、查尔酮糖苷和花青素糖苷。这些物质不仅赋予牡丹黄色，也是药用应用中的主要活性成分。此外，还筛选出多个可能参与调控MATE基因表达的转录因子。我们的研究证实了PdMATE16和PdMATE35在牡丹类黄酮转运中的关键作用，阐明了参与牡丹花色形成的转运过程调控机制，从而可能有助于观赏植物和药用植物的改良。
